title: promoteSuggestionOnMain does two independent on-main commits (issue file, then …
description:
promoteSuggestionOnMain does two independent on-main commits (issue file, then pen-line removal). If the process dies or the pen-removal commit is lost between the two, the fingerprint stays in the pen and a manual re-promote would file a duplicate issue (the embedded suggestion-fingerprint line prevents auto-review re-dedup, but not manual re-promote). Acceptable given pushMainBestEffort semantics; a note or a single-commit combine would be more robust.
